job_deposit_note: Included in customer 1-NEAR funding, not extra source capital. 0.32768 NEAR storage reserves are retained permanently; 0.02 escrow is transferred/refunded internally.
callback_note: Two 40-Tgas callback allocations are carved out of the successful 150-Tgas settlement/refund calls, already included in 2250; do not add them twice.
calculation_note: 19x300 Tgas plus conservative action/receipt envelope and creation-charge allowance at snapshot prices. This overcounts some costs deliberately; not an actual fee quote.
stop_rule: No transaction may exceed fixed amounts or the 1-NEAR aggregate fee cap, 2-NEAR deployment/base-state allowance or 7-NEAR resource allocation. Recheck live prices, balances and remaining headroom; stop and request revised approval if any cap would be exceeded. No topups or extra/retry transactions.
